label: Ollama
description: Local Ollama gateway for Settings → LLMs. Point at your Ollama server URL (default http://localhost:11434). Install from Store → Gateways, then enable to show the Ollama row under Providers & Keys.

steps.title: Open Ollama
steps.body: Press the Ollama row in this table. The page slides open so you can set the server URL.

steps.title: Ollama URL
steps.body: Leave the default http://localhost:11434 or paste your Ollama server URL.

steps.title: Test & Save
steps.body: Press Test & Save to confirm Ollama is reachable.

steps.title: Back
steps.body: Press Back to return to the provider list.
